Geospatial, Text & Prefix Indexes

A normal database index sorts one thing in one line. "Drivers near me", "words that start with ca", "documents about Kafka lag" and "images that look like this one" are not one-line questions. After this page you will know the special index for each, how it works inside, and which one to name in an interview.

sections.before:
You might confuse this with... a trie answers "which words start with these letters" (prefix), an inverted index answers "which documents contain these words" (anywhere in the text), and a vector index answers "which items mean something similar" (no shared words needed). "iphone ca" is a trie query, "red running shoes" is an inverted-index query, "something for a rainy hike" is a vector query.
